name: observability-instrumentation
description: Instrument services for observability — structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics naming conventions, and the three-pillar model. Use when asked about "add logging", "structured logs", "distributed tracing", "trace ID", "metrics", "Prometheus", "OpenTelemetry", "why can't I debug production issues", or "correlate logs across services".
